# উখিয়া বিদ্যুৎ বিল (Ukhiya Electricity Bill)

> স্বচ্ছ বিল, সচেতন গ্রাহক — Ukhiya, Cox's Bazar residents track, compare, and report electricity bills.

A community platform for Ukhiya upazila residents to submit electricity bill data (via image OCR), compare against local union averages, receive AI-powered usage insights, and stay updated with government notices and power-outage announcements. UI is in Bangla; data is aggregated and anonymized.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview, features, and call to action
- [Public Notices](/notices): Government notices, outages, tariff changes
- [Sign in / Register](/auth): Email or Google authentication

## Public API (for Android app / third parties)
- [Announcements](/api/public/announcements): GET — recent published announcements (optional ?category= & ?limit=)
- [Aggregate stats](/api/public/stats): GET — anonymized bill averages by union
